nodes.notes: Rejects empty or truncated Gemini output before chunking and records the extraction engine.

return rows.map((row,i)=>{const r=Array.isArray(row)?row[0]:row;if(!r?.id)throw new Error(`CHUNK_CREATE_FAILED item=${i}`);return {json:{chunk_id:r.id,document_version_id:r.document_version_id,product_id:r.product_id,chunk_index:r.chunk_index,content:r.content,content_hash:r.content_hash,language_code:r.language_code,metadata:r.metadata}};});

nodes.name: Structured Extraction Qwen1
nodes.notes: Primary structured extraction: max_tokens=8192, at most 6 concise writes. Transport retries 3 times; parser truncation routes to split fallback.

nodes.name: Validate Structured Writes1
nodes.notes: Validates/deduplicates writes; skips malformed fragments, normalizes file-format directions and extensions, and rejects non-file directions such as install.

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{status:'all_files_completed',files_received:$input.all().length,finished_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];

nodes.name: Prepare Structured Extraction Batches1
nodes.notes: INPUT: schema_contract + normalized_text. OUTPUT: các batch tuần tự tối đa 8.000 ký tự, kèm batch_index/batch_count.

nodes.name: Loop Over Structured Batches1
nodes.notes: Xử lý từng batch AI tuần tự để tránh quá tải và output truncation.

nodes.name: Parse Structured Batch1
nodes.notes: Parses complete JSON. Truncated output is routed to automatic two-half fallback instead of terminating the ingestion.

nodes.name: Loop Over Structured Writes1
nodes.notes: Ghi từng structured fact/provenance tuần tự; output done mới được finalize.

nodes.name: List Drive Folder Files1
nodes.notes: INPUT: sự kiện fileCreated. OUTPUT: toàn bộ file được hỗ trợ trong folder để Loop Over Files xử lý tuần tự.

nodes.name: Normalize Drive Folder Files1
nodes.notes: Loại file không hỗ trợ, loại trùng theo Google Drive file ID và sắp xếp ổn định trước khi vào loop.

nodes.name: Normalize Product Document Lookup1
nodes.notes: INPUT: kết quả lookup product_documents. OUTPUT: đúng một item với document_exists và existing_document_id.

nodes.name: File Processing Failed1
nodes.notes: Một file lỗi download/parser sẽ được ghi nhận failed rồi trả về Loop Over Files, không dừng cả folder.

nodes.name: Prepare Whole Office OCR Batch
nodes.notes: Splits DOCX by logical OOXML body blocks and PPTX by slides before Gemini OCR; prunes unreachable package assets and caps oversized batches.

nodes.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash OCR1
nodes.notes: One Gemini request per page batch; each batch retries independently up to four attempts.

nodes.name: Loop Over Gemini OCR Batches
nodes.notes: Runs one page batch at a time so Gemini retries are independent per batch.

nodes.name: Merge Gemini OCR Batches in Page Order
Encode Current OCR Batch
nodes.notes: Converts only the current loop batch to base64, avoiding whole-file base64 duplication in execution data.

nodes.name: Throttle Gemini OCR Requests
nodes.notes: Waits five seconds between successful OCR batches to stay below Gemini free-tier request-rate limits.

nodes.name: Prepare Structured Fallback Halves1
nodes.notes: Splits only the truncated parent batch into two balanced source halves.

nodes.name: Loop Over Structured Fallback Halves1
nodes.notes: Processes fallback halves sequentially.

nodes.name: Structured Extraction Qwen Fallback1
nodes.notes: Fallback extraction on half-sized source; max_tokens=8192 and at most 4 concise writes.

nodes.name: Parse Structured Fallback Half1
nodes.notes: Strict parser for half-batch fallback; a second truncation reports the exact half.

nodes.name: Merge Structured Fallback Halves1
nodes.notes: Merges both fallback half results into one parent batch result and returns it to the original loop.

parameters.jsCode: return {json:{status:'skipped',reason:'same source hash already fully ingested',file_id:$json.file_id,file_name:$json.file_name,document_id:$json.existing_document_id,document_version_id:$json.completed_version_id,source_url:$json.source_url,database_check:'product_id+source_url+source_hash+completed_current_version'}};
return $input.all().map((item,index)=>({json:{...item.json,structured_write_loop_reset:false},binary:item.binary,pairedItem:item.pairedItem??{item:index}}));

nodes.name: Continue Structured Write Loop1
nodes.notes: Clears the reset marker before returning one processed write to the inner loop.
